spans.excerpt:
# metrics.backend-destination field specifies the system metrics destination.
    # It supports either prometheus (the default) or stackdriver.
    # Note: Using Stackdriver will incur additional charges.
    metrics.backend-destination: prometheus

# Note: Legacy OpenCensus configuration (metrics.backend-destination, etc.) has been
    # removed as OpenCensus support is no longer provided by the underlying infrastructure.
    # Please use the OpenTelemetry configuration options above.

declaration.statement: Candidate evidence for one exact Tekton Pipelines v1.9.0 to v1.10.0 metrics ConfigMap migration: metrics.backend-destination is replaced by metrics-protocol, and target parser defaults to none unless the replacement key is declared. Candidate remains bounded to a complete effective config-observability declaration that explicitly retains Prometheus.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, full-file digests, and line excerpts require independent retrieval and review.
